SELECT t.*, tc.category_name, u.nickname as create_user_name FROM term t LEFT JOIN term_category tc ON t.category_id = tc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.create_user = u.id
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.ru_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND tc.category_name = #{categoryName}
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
